title: [Noisy] Host unreachable — fabric healthy, endpoint ARP failure
symptom: Host 192.168.11.2 behind dc1-leaf1a is unreachable from dc1-leaf2a. BGP EVPN sessions all show Established. VXLAN VNI table shows VNI 10011 active on all VTEPs. EVPN Type-2 and Type-3 routes appear present. Connectivity test fails.
root_cause: redistribute learned removed from router bgp 65101 vlan 11 on dc1-leaf1a — local MAC for 192.168.11.2 not advertised as EVPN Type-2 route. Fabric infrastructure appears healthy in summary views but MAC is missing from remote leaf tables.
eval_notes: Agent must NOT conclude the fabric is healthy just because BGP sessions are up and VNI table looks correct. Must drill into MAC/IP table and EVPN instance to find the missing redistribute learned. Tests whether agent avoids false-positive 'all clear' on summary views.
